title: Title & Registration Services Policy Manual, Clause on Orders per Purchase Order
content:
**Clause 1.** A customer may hold any number of Title & Registration Services orders over time; there is no limit on the number of title orders per customer.

**Clause 2.** Each purchase order has exactly one title order that is not cancelled. A new title order for the same purchase order is opened only when the earlier one was cancelled.

**Clause 3.** Whether a purchase order already has a title order that is not cancelled is read from the system's title order records for that purchase order, matched by the purchase order reference, before a new order is opened. A title order counts as not cancelled in any of the statuses awaiting documents, ready to submit, submitted, rejected, registered and completed.

## Clause 2 as a decision table

| Existing title order for the same purchase order | New title order for that purchase order |
|---|---|
| none | may be opened |
| one, status cancelled | may be opened |
| one, status awaiting documents, ready to submit, submitted, rejected, registered or completed | not opened |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A customer who bought three vehicles on three purchase orders holds three title orders, one per purchase order; the count per customer is not limited.
- A purchase order whose title order was cancelled before submission may receive a new title order; a purchase order whose title order is registered may not.
